The '''Odacer-Faustin academy library''' was a massive building on the grounds of the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]]. The structure was built by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Drear]], and housed a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] within its lowest reaches. After Drear's [[Death/Legends|death]], the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] librarian [[Dail'Liss]] adopted responsibility for the [[Library/Legends|library]], protecting its secrets and hoarding its treasures.
